title: A Pisces Already Planned the Wedding
topic: Pisces zodiac satire: a Pisces already planned the wedding
mechanism: Inside a Pisces there is a huge fish tank labelled DAYDREAMS that always overflows, a REALITY dial that fell off years ago, a TEARS tap nobody can close and a speaker playing SAD SONGS on repeat.

beats.hook: A coffee shop counter under a PISCES badge: the barista Sam smiles once at Mila and she is instantly at the altar with him in a pink dream
beats.story: Mila is dreamy and kind: she cries at sunsets, apologises to a chair she bumped, and has picked the dress, the song and the dog; Sara reminds her she doesn't even know his name
beats.rise: Every morning she comes back and every morning Sam smiles: Mila is sure it is fate
beats.twist: A woman walks behind the counter, kisses Sam and hands him his lunch: she wears a wedding ring; Mila turns and walks face-first into the glass door
beats.mechanism: Inside her head: a huge DAYDREAMS fish tank overflowing onto the floor, a REALITY dial lying on the wet floor, a TEARS tap that won't close, a SAD SONGS speaker on repeat
beats.ending: She cries one evening, feels fine, and the next morning at the flower shop the florist hands her a rose and smiles: Mila has already named their dog

seed.what: Sam's wife: her framed photo with Sam by the register, then she walks behind the counter
